samples.gvd:
module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter	WIDTH = 8,
    parameter 	DEPTH = 16,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define internal signals
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] ram_data;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] ram_out;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] waddr_bin;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] raddr_bin;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_buff;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wptr_syn;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rptr_syn;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] wfull_reg;
        reg [WIDTH-1:0] rempty_reg;
        
        // Connect input/output signals to RAM module
        assign wen = winc & !wfull_reg;
        assign ren = rinc & !rempty_reg;
        assign wdata = wdata;
        assign rdata = ram_out;
        
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) u_dual_port_RAM (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .rdec(ren),
            .waddr(waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .raddr(raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rdata(ram_out)
        );
        
        // Write pointer management
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (wen) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Read pointer management
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (ren) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Convert write pointer to Gray code
        always @(*) begin
            wptr[3] = waddr_bin[3];
            wptr[2] = waddr_bin[3] ^ waddr_bin[2];
            wptr[1] = waddr_bin[2] ^ waddr_bin[1];
            wptr[0] = waddr_bin[1] ^ waddr_bin[0];
        end
        
        // Convert read pointer to Gray code
        always @(*) begin
            rptr[3] = raddr_bin[3];
            rptr[2] = raddr_bin[3] ^ raddr_bin[2];
            rptr[1] = raddr_bin[2] ^ raddr_bin[1];
            rptr[0] = raddr_bin[1] ^ raddr_bin[0];
        end
        
        // Buffer write pointer
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Buffer read pointer
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize write pointer
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronize read pointer
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Full condition check
        always @(*) begin
            if ((wptr == {~rptr_syn[3], rptr_syn[2:0]})) begin
                wfull_reg = 1;
            end else begin
                wfull_reg = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Empty condition check
        always @(*) begin
            if (rptr == wptr_syn) begin
                rempty_reg = 1;
            end else begin
                rempty_reg = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign wfull = wfull_reg;
        assign rempty = rempty_reg;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>
        // Implement dual-port RAM here
        // Implement write and read controllers here
        // Implement read pointer synchronizers here
        // Implement write pointer synchronizers here
        // Implement empty/full generation logic here
    </implementation>
</module>
